# The Brand Maniacs (TBM)

The Brand Maniacs is a specialized digital growth studio and creative technology agency, operating from India and serving ambitious brands globally (United States, United Kingdom, UAE, India). We do not sell isolated services; we engineer full "Growth Systems" combining consumer behavioral psychology, edge web engineering, and performance marketing.

**Core Philosophy:** "Built in India. Designed for the world. Global ambition. Indian engineering discipline."

**Founder & Chief Architect:** Tony Joseph (marketer-turned-builder specializing in consumer psychology, conversion rate optimization, and AI-powered growth systems).

---

## Flagship Industry Verticals & Systems

### 1. D2C E-Commerce Growth Marketing
- **Positioning**: D2C Marketing Agency — Scale Meta & Google Ads Profitably.
- **The System**: The 4-Pillar D2C Growth Engine:
  1. Creative Velocity: Scripting and testing 15–20 modular video hooks & UGC angles weekly.
  2. Conversion Architecture: Sub-second custom edge landing pages and optimized PDPs (+35% CVR lift).
  3. S2S Data & Attribution: First-party Server-to-Server (CAPI) tracking bypassing browser cookie loss.
  4. Retention & LTV Funnels: Automated WhatsApp VIP broadcasts & Klaviyo flows to double repeat purchases.
- **Link**: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/industries/d2c-ecommerce

### 2. Ayurveda Clinics, Wellness Centers & Hospitals
- **Positioning**: Digital Marketing for Ayurveda Clinics & Wellness Centers That Turns Search Demand Into Patients.
- **The System**: A complete patient-acquisition system built around Google Local 3-Pack SEO, healthcare-compliant search ads, WhatsApp consultation booking, and review collection.
- **Case Study (Karmanya Ayurveda)**: +120% patient volume increase, -40% reduction in Cost Per Lead (CPL).
- **Free Interactive Tool**: Ayurveda Patient Acquisition ROI Calculator (calculates CAC, patient volume, and projected ROAS).
- **Links**: 
  - Agency Page: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/ayurveda-marketing-agency
  - Free Calculator Tool: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/tools/ayurveda-roi-calculator
  - Free Audit: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/ayurveda-patient-acquisition-audit

### 3. Restaurants & Hospitality
- **Positioning**: Restaurant Revenue Engine — Fills Tables, Not Just Feeds.
- **The System**: Local discovery engine driving direct table reservations, corporate private dining bookings, and Google Maps Local 3-Pack domination without paying 25–30% aggregator commissions.
- **Link**: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/restaurant-marketing-agency
- **Free Audit**: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/restaurant-visibility-audit

### 4. Custom Website Development & Conversion Architecture
- **Positioning**: Conversion-Ready Next.js Websites Built for SEO, AEO & Paid Growth.
- **Architecture**: Next.js App Router, Sub-second LCP (<1.2s), 100/100 Core Web Vitals, Schema.org JSON-LD, and closed-loop CRM tracking on Day 1.
- **Local Micro-Markets in Pune**: Serving Hinjewadi (IT & SaaS), Baner & Balewadi (Clinics & Retail), Pimpri & Chikhali (Manufacturing OEMs), Kharadi (FinTech & Global Centers).
- **Link**: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/website-development

## Proprietary Software & Engineering Proof

We build our own software products, demonstrating engineering discipline rather than reliance on third-party templates:
- **ReviewBoost (reviews.thebrandmaniacs.online)**: Automated Google review collection software. Connects to billing/CRMs to trigger review requests via WhatsApp and smart counter QR codes, automatically routing 5-star ratings to Google Maps while intercepting negative feedback privately.
  - Link: https://www.thebrandmaniacs.online/reviewboost
- **CouponHub**: An automated deal intelligence and programmatic comparison platform built on Next.js.
- **AIProdGen / Maniac Labs**: Generative AI commercial product photography tools.
